notes.title: Swarmlake 3.0 Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/cf74e60808f1e4198ef37d2f7f04bccc0c1b531b.png[/img]

Hi, the free Swarmlake 3.0 Update is out now:

[list]
[*]Added player health
[quote]Improves understandability of game overs which was by far the most common complaint since release. In the past the binary nature of one-hit deaths resulted in frustrations as there was no warning possible. Also increases the elasticity of the game challenge. This will affect the gameplay dynamic as it is now possible to intentionally take damage to get to a bomb.[/quote]
[*]Added bowl-shaped arena wall
[quote]Removes the punishing nature of falling off the arena while keeping effectively the same playspace as the recently introduced arena limit. As a reminder having a limited arena reduces the amount of invalid options such as running infinitely backwards/forwards or making too big of circles. Since the game gets harder over time this only ever resulted in slower and more frustrating deaths which were not obvious to understand. It also increases the required decision making and adds more positioning and meaning to space. So overall this improves the depth tree for both beginner and expert players.[/quote]
[*]Added wall jump
[*]Added bomb detonation healing a fraction of health
[*]Added health bar display
[*]Added player damage audiovisual feedback
[*]Added player top percent display to leaderboard
[*]Added leaderboard rank display
[*]Added settings tab to hide individual HUD elements
[*]Improved enemy jump sign display
[*]Improved shard despawn warning feedback clarity by increasing flicker speed over time
[*]Improved sound effects mix clarity
[*]Improved milestone score visual effect
[*]Improved startup speed
[*]Fixed startup delay if loading showcase failed
[*]Reset leaderboard and settings
[*]Decreased fire rate by 10%
[quote]Better fits expectations of when taking damage relative to enemy density. Also increases decision making by having to avoid enemies more and adapting to their patterns. This changes game feel so it might take some time to get used to it.[/quote]
[*]Increased bomb spawn height variation by 20%
[quote]Encourages more vertical play and reduces repetitive single jump strategies.[/quote]
[*]Increased enemy spawn scaling by 25%
[quote]Speeds up pacing and balances out the increased survivability of the player due to adding health.[/quote]
[/list]
Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Swarmlake has continuously evolved over time with the goal to make it more fun for more players by always keeping player feedback in mind. I am aware that people dislike change and I am sorry for the frustration this can cause.

Thank you
- Dominique

[*]Added settings tab to hide individual HUD elements
[*]Improved shard despawn warning feedback clarity by increasing flicker speed over time

tags.bug: [*]Fixed startup delay if loading showcase failed
[*]Reset leaderboard and settings

notes.title: Swarmlake 2.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/0474692530981e1d0c61811ca874fc83cfbe9a3e.jpg[/img]

Hey all, Swarmlake 2.14 is out to improve understandability and depth:

[list]
[*]Added arena limit
[quote]Increases the required decision making and adds more positioning and meaning to space. It improves the depth tree for both expert and beginner players. For the latter it reduces the amount of invalid options such as running infinitely backwards/forwards or making too big of circles. Since the game gets harder over time this only ever resulted in slower and more frustrating deaths which were not obvious to understand.[/quote]
[*]Improved enemy spawning to be independent of player look direction
[quote]Less punishment and more freedom of where players look. While this increases uncertainty of where enemies spawn there is still no randomness as it is the same sequence for everyone. Especially players now need to adapt more to reach bomb enemies which makes the game more dynamic.[/quote]
[*]Improved avoider (orange) enemy projectile avoidance to be a bigger threat
[quote]Makes this enemy more noticeable and reduces situations where player vision is completely blocked by enemies.[/quote]
[*]Improved bomb min move height (now can trigger without jumping if pulled down)
[quote]Increases discoverability of detonating bombs. If a bomb is not hit by a projectile and therefore possibly pulled down they still require jumping to detonate.[/quote]
[*]Fixed jumping off of bombs
[*]Fixed showing wrong leaderboard avatar in rare cases
[*]Removed replacing bombs on spawn limit (now pauses spawning at limit)
[quote]Encourages more dynamic player movement patterns. In the past players could ignore existing bombs and move in an infinite circle as the farthest bombs would despawn and new ones would keep spawning in front of them.[/quote]
[*]Removed score-based fire-rate (now always at max rate)
[quote]Increases death consistency as it is tightly linked to fire-rate. This also makes the early game easier.[/quote]
[*]Removed doubled enemy spawn scaling after 10,000 score (now as before 10k)
[*]Reset leaderboard
[/list]
Please keep in mind that the max highscores will be lower now due to the gameplay changes. Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Congratulations to the top ten players and everyone else who competed the past year:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/7f7be64b2beef22ed8ed5d2f76cf99380a22cf80.jpg[/img]

Swarmlake has continuously evolved over time with the goal to make it more fun for more players. I am aware that people dislike change and I am sorry for the frustration this can cause.

Thank you
- Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake 2.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/6c2c18ce2e563a2c706f467ee2104952fea1c5de.jpg[/img]

Hey all, Swarmlake 2.9 is out aiming to improve the game based on recent feedback:

[list]
[*]Decreased distance of replacing bomb on spawn limit when far away from player by 40%
[*]Decreased time-based enemy spawn scaling by 20% (same as before 2.8)
[*][strike]Readded score-based bomb spawn limit[/strike] (reverted)
[*]Fixed replacing farthest bomb on spawn limit in rare cases
[*]Removed replacing invisible bomb on spawn limit
[*]Reset leaderboard
[/list]

Touching bombs is one of the core tensions of the game. Interesting decisions emerge from moving towards bombs (reward) while judging (uncertainty) how to best avoid enemies (cost).

Having bombs move to the player undermines this dynamic as it was better to move in an endless circle and ignore bombs until they were close. Players wanting to win were forced to play this way which reduced depth. Therefore bomb movement was removed in the recent updates.

However this increased uncertainty due to the increased time to reach bombs. This update aims to address this.

Unfortunately the leaderboard also had to be reset.

Thank you for your understanding, feedback and support
- Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31953633/b79854fe35bb959bf4f404895a033f81106b1dea.jpg[/img]

Hey all, Swarmlake 1.0 is out featuring a new engine with improved visuals, audio, gameplay, performance and much more:
[list]
[*]Added new data-oriented engine to maximize performance
[*]Added partial projectile ground hit reflection
[*]Added audio-visual effect when reaching final achievement score and multiples of it
[*]Added visual bomb pulse effect
[*]Added new shoot sound
[*]Added new achievement icons
[*]Improved jump arc control by decreasing fall speed by 25% (same as before Update 18)
[*]Improved jump height control by decreasing grounded jump height by 20%
[*]Improved ability to stop bombs by increasing bomb projectile hit radius by 33%
[*]Improved death consistency and feedback
[*]Improved bomb min and max height bounce behavior
[*]Improved bomb outline visibility
[*]Improved visual vibrancy
[*]Improved CPU performance by ~33%
[*]Improved game startup speed
[*]Improved audio mix clarity
[*]Improved UI visibility
[*]Fixed 6,000+ score-based shoot rate increase not activating
[*]Fixed last shard and gun flicker not activating
[*]Fixed projectiles hitting spawning enemies during animation after first animation frame
[*]Fixed projectiles now hitting closest enemy when hitting multiple enemies in the same frame
[*]Fixed player now dying from closest enemy when hitting multiple enemies in the same frame
[*]Fixed jumping off of bombs
[*]Fixed removing invisible bombs on bomb spawn limit to be field of view independent
[*]Fixed death enemy highlight to be visible through ground
[*]Fixed key rebind new key detection issue
[*]Fixed key rebind UI button focus loss
[*]Fixed some font symbols
[*]Fixed some user settings by resetting all to default
[/list]

Swarmlake 1.0 started by completely rewriting the custom game engine to use a data-oriented design in order to maximize the performance. This made me rethink and reimplement almost all gameplay logic again and allowed me to find hidden bugs. I am very confident in the results and hope that you will enjoy this extremely polished experience.

For years even after initial release lots of community-requested features and improvements were added with continued full-time development to increase the overall value and quality of Swarmlake by including better gameplay, balance, visuals, effects, lighting, animations, audio, performance, user interface, accessibility, achievements, persistent in-game global/friends leaderboard, trading cards, full controller support, rebindable keybindings and so much more. Therefore the price was adapted to reflect the current state of Swarmlake.

Thanks to everyone for your continued support since your feedback was essential for shaping up Swarmlake!

Thank you
- Dominique

notes.title: Swarmlake Update 18
notes.content:
Why burst jumping was replaced with a normal jump:[list][*]Burst jumping is either exploitable or unusable due to looking away which requires enemy pushback to make usable. See: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P91YPnAaeTg
[*]Burst jumping causes deaths which are perceived as random since you need to look away
[*]Burst jumping is difficult for the sake of it (look down+shoot+look up instead of just jumping)
[*]Burst jumping is hard to learn, hard to master (instead of easy to learn, hard to master)
[*]Burst shooting has zero usage outside burst jumping
[/list]

You now jump off the ground and enemies directly below you using [SPACE] key. I understand that this makes the game feel different and may require some time to get used to if you played it before.

The identity of Swarmlake is to fight a swarm of billions of enemies and the challenge should come from learning how to move through massive amount of enemies while triggering bombs and collecting points and NOT from difficult controls.

Update 18 changelog:[list][*]Replaced burst jump/shooting with normal jump
[*]Increased bomb explosion radius by 14%
[*]Increased fall speed by 33%
[*]Decreased jump height by 17%
[*]Added keybinding tutorial screen

[*]Improved some icons and keybind names
[*]Fixed restart music fade effect in some cases
[*]Fixed credits text clipping
[*]Tweaked volume of some sound effects
[*]Reset leaderboard
[/list]

Thank you,
Dominique
